decisions.reason: As a recently launched line close to the core safety-footwear business, it fits the firm's public innovation direction and prior development effort, so management is likely to continue backing it unless there is clear evidence of sustained failure.

This product sits squarely in the firm's established occupational-footwear competence and can still be justified as part of a broader technology-led offer, which makes escalation of commitment favor retention.

A safety shoe series is highly central to the firm's announced strategy and core market presence, so sunk development costs and visible commitment make management especially likely to keep it on the market.
